speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, slightly hushed] What if you woke up... and the WHOLE world was Roblox?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Every street. Every person. Every... chicken.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [building tension] And to survive, everyone had to pick ONE game.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [rushed] You picked the hardest one.

speaker: NOVA
text: [shouts, confident] You coming or what, noob?!

speaker: YOU
text: [shouts, panicked] I'M COMING! I'm totally fine, I'm— [screams] AAAAAH!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [sighs, playful] Okay. Okay. Let me back up.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly, mysterious] It's two A.M. You should be asleep. [pause] You are not asleep.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] You're playing Steal an Egg. Just one more round. [pause] That was forty rounds ago.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [curious] Then, rolling down the egg belt... something you've never seen before.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [glitchy, robotic] Secret Egg. Price: question mark. Question mark. Question mark.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, amazed] Ohhh... what is THAT?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You tap it. [pause] It's free. [pause] Nothing good is ever free.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [robotic] Before hatching, please enter your username.

speaker: YOU
text: [sleepy, mumbling] Mm... username... uhh... [yawns] ...you?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] You typed "YOU." In all caps. [pause] Remember that. It's important.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, building] The egg cracks. Pixels pour out of the screen... and EVERYTHING goes— [shouts] BLOCKY!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [bright, excited] Morning! Your alarm clock doesn't ring. [pause] It's... loading.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [robotic] Loading... twelve percent.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then you look at your hands. [pause] Blocks. Shiny plastic blocks.

speaker: YOU
text: [gasps] My hands! [rushed] Where are my FINGERS?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You run to the mirror. [pause] Your head is a cube. And your hair is one solid piece... of orange plastic.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [curious] You grab it. And it just... comes off.

speaker: YOU
text: [disbelief] I'm BALD! [nervous laugh] Okay, okay... it clicks back on. Hair is an accessory now. That's fine. That's FINE.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And floating above your head, in big white letters... "YOU."

speaker: YOU
text: [groans] Ugh. Two A.M. me... you absolute noob.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Downstairs, Mom calls you for breakfast. But now her words pop up in a chat bubble.

speaker: MOM
text: [cheerful, sing-song] Breakfast is ready, honey!

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] Mom... did you just get filtered?

speaker: MOM
text: [annoyed, sing-song] I said HONEY!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [laughs] Roblox thinks "honey" is a bad word. Mom's been filtered eleven times since sunrise.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Breakfast is a pancake. You don't eat it. You EQUIP it.

speaker: YOU
text: [chewing, then disappointed] Mmm... [pause] tastes like a plastic frisbee.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And Dad? [pause] Dad never customized his avatar. Yellow head. Blue shirt. Green pants. The classic noob.

speaker: DAD
text: [proud, deadpan] I'm not a noob. I'm VINTAGE.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: He's been trying to sit on the couch for twenty minutes. He keeps sitting INSIDE it.

speaker: DAD
text: [calm] I'm comfortable. [pause] I'm part of the couch now.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, building] You step outside... and WOW.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The street is a giant gray baseplate. The sun is a perfect square. The clouds are... also squares. Everything is squares.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your neighbor is a seven-foot banana. [pause] Yesterday, he was a dentist.

speaker: BANANA
text: [cheerful, goofy] Morning, YOU! Floss daily!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [rushed, playful] A kid on a rainbow jetpack. A lady in thirty-seven hats. And a hot dog who hasn't stopped dancing since six A.M.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [amazed] And it's not just your street. It's EVERYWHERE.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [like a sports commentator, speeding up] The Eiffel Tower? An obby. The Great Wall? A REALLY long obby. The ocean? [pause] A kill brick.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [amazed] Eight billion people. One server. [pause] The ping is... not great.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then the sky goes dark... and a GIANT message appears.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, robotic] ATTENTION, PLAYERS. Welcome to Roblox Earth.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming] By sunset, every player must enter ONE game. Players without a game... will be kicked.

speaker: YOU
text: [gulps] Kicked... from EARTH?!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, then suddenly cheerful] Have fun!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited] And then... the portals open.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Hundreds of glowing doorways, right in the middle of town. Every single one is a different game.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] "Tower of Pain." "Adopt Me Maybe." "Brookhaven't." "Natural Disasters... but REAL."

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And everyone has to choose.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mom picks Brookhaven't. Instantly, she owns a pink mansion, a pink car... and a pink horse?

speaker: MOM
text: [dreamy] I'm finally living my best life, honey!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [laughs] Filtered again.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Dad picks Fishing Simulator. He sits on a dock. He doesn't move. [pause] He's never been happier.

speaker: DAD
text: [peaceful, happy sigh] ...Peace and quiet.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The banana dentist picks Tower of Pain. [pause] He falls off the first step.

speaker: BANANA
text: [falling, fading away] Ohhhhh nooooo...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And Grandma picks DOORS. [pause] Ten seconds later... the monster runs out screaming.

speaker: MONSTER
text: [screaming, terrified] SHE'S TOO FAST!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softer, curious] And then you see it. One portal... flickering. Glitching. With a familiar egg on the sign.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [ominous] "STEAL AN EGG." [pause] The game that started all of this.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous, then pumped] Okay. Okay okay okay. [deep breath] Let's GO!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited] You jump in.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Welcome to Steal an Egg! Tip: always lock your base!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quickly] Remember that tip. [pause] You won't.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You spawn in your own empty base. And the sign out front says... "YOU's Base."

speaker: YOU
text: [annoyed] "YOU's"? That's not even grammar!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: In the middle of the map, a conveyor belt rolls eggs past every base. Dirt Egg: ten bucks. Rare Egg: five thousand. Legendary Egg: one MILLION.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [mysterious] And for just one second... a glitchy egg with three question marks rolls by. [pause] Then it's gone.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers] ...Did anyone else see that?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [snappy] Rule one: eggs hatch into pets. Pets make money. Money buys better eggs. [pause] It's basically a job... with chickens.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Rule two: you can steal ANY egg, from ANY base. But when you carry one, it sits on top of your head, you run at half speed... [pause] and EVERYONE can see it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Rule three: lock your base.

speaker: YOU
text: [confident] Got it. Easy.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] It was not easy.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You have zero dollars. So you do the starter quest: "Touch Grass."

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You touch the grass. [pause] Ten dollars. [laughs] Roblox literally paid you to touch grass.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You buy a Dirt Egg. It wobbles... it cracks... and out comes—

speaker: YOU
text: [softly, amazed] ...a rock. With legs.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One dollar per second.

speaker: YOU
text: [in love, emotional] I'm gonna call you Rocky. You're perfect. I would DIE for you, Rocky.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You spend three minutes showing Rocky to... literally no one. And you forget rule three.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [rushed] A tiny blur zooms into your base. "xX_Speedy_Xx." He's seven. He's the fastest thief on the server.

speaker: SPEEDY
text: [high-pitched, giggling] Yoink!

speaker: YOU
text: [shouts, devastated] ROCKY! NOOOO!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You chase him. You're fast. He's FASTER. He slams his laser door right in your face. And behind it... Speedy has two hundred rocks.

speaker: YOU
text: [crying, dramatic] Why does a seven-year-old need two hundred ROCKS?!

speaker: SPEEDY
text: [smug] Collection.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [determined] Fine. If they can steal... so can you.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You pick the biggest target on the server. Number one on the leaderboard: "xX_EggLord_Xx."

speaker: NARRATOR
text: His base is solid gold. Lasers. Ten Legendary eggs. And a sign that says... "TRY IT."

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, sneaky] Sneak... sneak... sneak...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You grab a Legendary egg. It lands on your head. [pause] It weighs as much as a fridge.

speaker: YOU
text: [straining] Why is it so HEAVY?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Alarms. Sirens. And EggLord... slowly turns around.

speaker: EGGLORD
text: [bored, cocky] ...Bro. Seriously?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The lasers go ZAP.

speaker: YOU
text: [dazed, flat] ...oof.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You respawn in your empty base. No Rocky. No egg. No dignity.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softer, building] And that's when you see her.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A blur. Running straight through EggLord's lasers... with THREE eggs stacked on her head. At FULL speed.

speaker: YOU
text: [amazed] That's... that's impossible! You're supposed to be SLOW!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [like a sports commentator, speeding up] She slides under one laser, wall-jumps over two, backflips over the guard... and lands in her base. Door locked. Perfect.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Her name tag says "Nova."

speaker: NOVA
text: [cool, amused] Nice name tag... YOU.

speaker: YOU
text: [flustered, rushed] Thanks! It's— uh— it's a long story, I typed it at two A.M., and—

speaker: NOVA
text: [smirking] Tip, noob. [pause] Never steal a Legendary egg in Common shoes.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And she's gone.

speaker: YOU
text: [dreamy sigh] ...She called me noob.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] That's when you decide two things. One: you're gonna become the greatest egg thief this world has ever seen. [pause] Two... you need better shoes.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quick, cheerful] Oh! Quick thing. Everyone who subscribes gets a FREE Legendary egg in the new world.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [whispers] It's a normal egg. Painted gold. Don't tell anyone.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And if you DON'T subscribe... your only pet is a rock. Forever. [pause] Like me.

speaker: YOU
text: [sad, small voice] I miss Rocky.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [energetic] So you grind.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [rushed] Touch grass. Touch grass. Touch grass. Buy egg. Hatch egg. A chicken in sunglasses! A dog made of toast! A floating eyeball that just... stares.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One dollar a second. Fifty. A THOUSAND. Your base gets bigger. And shinier.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You practice stealing. You get zapped. And zapped. And zapped. One thousand and forty-seven times.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And finally... you buy the Speed Coil.

speaker: YOU
text: [excited] NEW SHOES!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You zoom. You fly. You run straight into a wall.

speaker: YOU
text: [muffled, face in the wall] ...worth it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And one night... you go back to Speedy's base. Two hundred rocks. All the same. But one of them... looks back at you.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, emotional] Rocky...?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warm] Rocky.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You carry him home on your head, at half speed, crying the whole way.

speaker: YOU
text: [crying happily] You're home, buddy. You're HOME.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You keep running into Nova. Well... mostly, she keeps stealing from you.

speaker: NOVA
text: [playful] Thanks for the egg, YOU!

speaker: YOU
text: [shouts] THAT WAS MY EGG!

speaker: NOVA
text: [laughs] Was.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You try stealing from her once. [pause] Banana peel trap.

speaker: NOVA
text: [laughs] Classic.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But then, one evening... at the egg belt...

speaker: NOVA
text: [quieter, curious] You saw it too, didn't you? The question mark egg.

speaker: YOU
text: [surprised] You saw it?!

speaker: NOVA
text: [serious] It's the Secret Egg. It's in the Admin Vault. The final level. Nobody's ever beaten it.

speaker: NOVA
text: [softer] Some people say... if you hatch it, the world goes back to normal.

speaker: YOU
text: [curious] And what do YOU think?

speaker: NOVA
text: [smirks] I think... I'm getting it first.

speaker: YOU
text: [hopeful] Wanna... team up?

speaker: NOVA
text: [snappy] Ha. No.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She walks away. [pause] Then she stops.

speaker: NOVA
text: [over her shoulder, smug] ...Keep up, and maybe.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited] So you KEEP UP. Leaderboard: number eight billion... fifty thousand... three hundred... number THREE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Number two: Nova. Number one... EggLord.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming] Server event! EGG RAIN!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Eggs fall from the sky! The whole server goes crazy. Mom drives through in her pink car. And Dad catches one... with his fishing rod.

speaker: DAD
text: [calm, pleased] Huh. Biggest fish I ever caught.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, epic] The Admin Vault is now OPEN. Entry fee: ONE BILLION dollars.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You check your money. [pause] Nine hundred ninety-nine million, nine hundred ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-nine.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] One dollar SHORT?! NOOO!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [pause] And then... [pause] bloop.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [chirpy] Plus one dollar!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warm] Rocky. One dollar per second. Right on time.

speaker: YOU
text: [shouts with joy] ROCKY, I LOVE YOU!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [epic, building] The Admin Vault floats above the clouds. Four stages. One egg. And only three players brave enough to go in.

speaker: EGGLORD
text: [cocky, laughing] Oh look, the noob and the girl. Good luck. You're gonna need it.

speaker: NOVA
text: [unbothered, cold] Talk less, EggLord. Run more.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [tense] Stage one: the Laser Hall. Red beams, sweeping in every direction.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Nova is fast. But not fast enough. One beam clips her shoe.

speaker: NOVA
text: [gasps] Ah—!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [proud] But you? You've been zapped one thousand and forty-seven times. You KNOW lasers.

speaker: YOU
text: [confident, focused] Left. [pause] Wait... [pause] Jump— NOW!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She lands perfectly. And she looks at you.

speaker: NOVA
text: [impressed, trying to hide it] ...Not bad, noob.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Stage two: the Hatchery. A thousand eggs. One is real. The rest...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [scared] ...have TEETH.

speaker: YOU
text: [screams] WHY DO THE EGGS HAVE TEETH?!

speaker: NOVA
text: [shouts] DON'T TOUCH THE PURPLE ONES!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You touch a purple one.

speaker: YOU
text: [muffled, inside the egg] ...I touched a purple one.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Nova grabs your legs and PULLS. Pop! You're free.

speaker: NOVA
text: [laughs] You owe me.

speaker: YOU
text: [grinning] Put it on my tab.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [epic] Stage three: the Top. And there it is... the Secret Egg.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [tense] But EggLord gets there first.

speaker: EGGLORD
text: [triumphant] MINE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The Secret Egg lands on his head. And remember rule two?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Half speed. And EVERYONE can see it.

speaker: NOVA
text: [quick, smirking] You thinking what I'm thinking?

speaker: YOU
text: [smirking] Banana peel?

speaker: NOVA
text: [laughs] Banana peel.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Slip! EggLord flies. The Secret Egg flies even higher—

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [like a sports commentator, speeding up] You JUMP! You CATCH it! And now YOU are the one at half speed!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming] Vault closing in TEN seconds!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [rushed, tense] Nine. The hatch pad is all the way across the vault. You're too slow. You'll never make it.

speaker: YOU
text: [shouts] NOVA! CATCH!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You throw it. She catches it. She runs. Full speed. Seven. Six.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Lasers. Teeth eggs. EggLord, still screaming somewhere. Five. Four.

speaker: NOVA
text: [shouts] YOU! Your turn!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She throws it back. Three. You dive. Two. She dives.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [shouts] ONE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [long pause] Two hands. One egg. On the pad. At the exact same time.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, triumphant] VAULT COMPLETE! CO-OP HATCH!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [soft, amazed] The Secret Egg glows. It cracks. Light everywhere...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And out pops... a tiny, glitchy... pixel chick.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [gentle] Congratulations, YOU and Nova. Reward: one wish.

speaker: NOVA
text: [softly] It's your call, noob.

speaker: YOU
text: [thoughtful] We could turn the world back to normal... [pause] ...tomorrow.

speaker: NOVA
text: [curious, smirking] Why tomorrow?

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] 'Cause today... I've got something to do.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warm, playful] So you go to the shop. Flowers are a game pass. They cost... every single dollar you have.

speaker: YOU
text: [no hesitation] Worth it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You find her on the roof of her base, watching the square sun go down.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your face turns red. Like, actually red. There's a blush texture now.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous, stammering] S-so... uh... these are for you.

speaker: NOVA
text: [teasing] For me? [pause] Or for YOU?

speaker: YOU
text: [flustered, rushed] For you! Not me-YOU, you-you! You. [pause] ...I'm changing my username.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [pause] She looks at the flowers. She looks at you. [pause] And she smirks.

speaker: NOVA
text: [cool, warm smirk] Smooth... YOU. [pause] Real smooth.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She takes the flowers.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Nova accepted your gift!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warm] And for the first time since the world turned into Roblox...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] you forget how to walk.

speaker: YOU
text: [dreamy, fainting] ...oof.

speaker: NOVA
text: [laughs softly] Noob.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, fast] Which portal would YOU pick? Tell me in the comments! And comment "EGG" if you'd pick Steal an Egg too.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful, slowing down] And the wish? [pause] Still unused. Because honestly...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warm] some things are just better in Roblox.
